summary_zh: 泰國投資申請連續55季成長，政府赴日、韓招商，鎖定汽車、電子與電動車零件；XPeng也考慮在泰設廠。Delta泰國廠轉向高附加價值製造並加強本地研發，Kawasaki新機器人控制器強化資安以符合歐盟網路韌性法，顯示製造商須同步提升研發與出口合規能力。
summary_en: Thailand's investment applications grew for a 55th straight quarter as officials courted Japan and Korea. Delta's Thai plant is shifting to higher-value manufacturing with local R&D, and Kawasaki added security features to meet the EU Cyber Resilience Act. R&D and compliance now matter more.
